next_step: Run hosted API POC w/ streaming + tool-calling traces; validate 95th-pct latency and end-to-end flow (wk of 2026-03-09)
notes:
Background: SalesRelay is a mid-market sales enablement SaaS (outbound + SDR workflows). Evaluating Redwood for real-time outbound chat agents that can call internal CRM/email/calendar tools.

Current ask: Proof-of-concept on Hosted API first (fast time-to-value) to validate streaming + tool-calling latency, then migrate to Dedicated for predictable throughput if hosts meet SLOs and price is acceptable.

Key quotes: "Need sub-500ms turn latency for outbound flows, ideally 95th-pct per-token under ~200ms to keep feeling realtime for reps." — Head of Product.

Security: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS for keys. Want explicit US-residency for PII-heavy snippets; prefer VPC support for Dedicated.

Integration scope: CRM (Salesforce) write actions, Gmail/send, Calendar/create invites, and small-chain tool calling to fetch prospect context. Must support streaming responses so rep sees partial suggestions while agent executes tool calls.

Commercial: Typical mid-market price sensitivity; pref initial hosted spend then switch to reserved Dedicated commit if ARR justification holds. Estimate ARR $100-250k if 10k active seats.

POC asks: sample prompts, tool-calling examples, streaming latency measurements, cost estimates for hybrid (hosted + occasional dedicated burst).

Concise status: demo done 2026-02-05; security screen kickoff 2026-02-18; POC scheduled week of Mar 9. AE pushing pricing scenarios for Dedicated annual commit.

AE notes (shorthand): prioritize latency numbers, show streaming + tool-call end-to-end trace, include rollback/fallback story (hosted -> dedicated -> fallback model).

poc_plan: Phase 1 (hosted API, 7 days): integrate outbound agent prototype, enable streaming, implement 3 tool calls (Salesforce write, Gmail send, Calendar create).
Measure: 95th-pct token latency, end-to-end turn latency, token cost per convo.
Phase 2 (scale test): replay 10k interactions/day to validate throughput; observe batching/kv cache effects.
Phase 3 (pricing & dedicated eval): run cost model with Dedicated TCO vs hosted-run; if latency/throughput or cost justify, propose Dedicated commit options.
requirements_summary: Outbound SDR chat agents that can make authenticated tool calls (CRM/email/calendar) and stream token responses to reps with tight latency SLOs. Need SSO/SAML, SOC2, audit logs, KMS, and US data residency. Initial POC on hosted API; potential move to Dedicated for predictable capacity and lower per-token cost.
latency_targets: 95th-pct token latency target: <=200ms; end-to-end turn latency target: <=500ms for typical 2-3 turn interactions. Throughput target: sustain ~200 concurrent agent sessions per region during peak.
model_preferences: Prefer open or verified models that support tool-calling + streaming; low-cost quantized variants acceptable for Dedicated. Want fallback variants for capacity degradation.
notes_from_calls: Head of Product: 'If reps see lag, adoption drops. Streaming + tool-call simultaneity is non-negotiable.'
CTO: 'We'll need an architecture doc showing VPC/Private options for Dedicated; SOC2 proof before procurement.'
AE: 'Plan: validate hosted perf, then price Dedicated commit — CFO expects a 12mo ARR justification.'
